Author: Sanctum
Name: Sanctum Presets
Punchline: Named presets and notes for the Sanctum VFX Penumbra mod.
Description: Pick effects for each Sanctum VFX slot with searchable dropdowns, recolor each slot with its own color, save setups as named presets, switch looks with one click or /sanctum <preset>, and keep notes linked to effects and presets that export to a .txt file. Requires Penumbra and the Sanctum VFX 4-Slot mod.
